title: Derivatives of a mollification are bounded by the L¹ norm
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ be C^∞ with compact support, and q ∈ ℕ. Then there is a constant C such that ‖D^q(φ ∗ g)(x)‖ ≤ C ∫ |g| dLⁿ for every Lebesgue-integrable g : ℝⁿ → ℝ and every x ∈ ℝⁿ, where (φ ∗ g)(x) = ∫ φ(t) g(x − t) dLⁿ(t) and D^q is the q-th Fréchet derivative.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : Eucl n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∀ q : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ g : Eucl n → ℝ, Integrable g volume → ∀ x : Eucl n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ q (convolution φ g (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) x‖ ≤ C * ∫ y, |g y| ∂volume
